t: Titan TTB890SDR_A electric 1/2 sheet sander engineered for efficient dry sanding across wood, plastic, metal, fillers and coated surfaces. The powerful 300W sheet sander provides quick and fine finishes on flat surfaces, making it suitable for preparing timber for painting, smoothing plaster repairs, or refining metalwork in workshops and on site. Offers a 6-speed variable control for optimal material removal, hook and loop or clamp fixing options for secure sheet attachment, and a dust vacuum facility that maintains a cleaner workspace. A soft-grip handle ensures comfort during prolonged use, while dust-sealed bearings contribute to the tool's durability and longevity. Includes 2.5m cable, providing ample reach for diverse tasks. Can be only used for dry operation without water or other coolants.
